scope: Give an accessible success/failure result when the user copies the redacted transient Editor diagnostics; a browser clipboard denial must not create an unhandled rejection.

implementation.copy_safety: Copy includes only the existing normalized, redacted diagnostic code/message/path fields; raw Error, stack, query values and unfiltered context remain excluded.
implementation.permission_recovery: Clipboard access is awaited inside a try/catch. Success and denied/unavailable outcomes are shown in an aria-live status region; blocked access offers a manual-copy next step and does not recurse into diagnostics.
implementation.draft_invariants: This change does not alter Page Model state, Save, Publish, API requests, D1 or R2.
